blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur— Police arrested 48 drug suspects and confiscated at least P1.7 million worth of suspected shabu during a weeklong series of synchronized anti-criminality operations across Caraga (Region 13), a police official said Monday.
